lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: You're here, Mr. Gourmand.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Excellent work, Commander.
You're both here already?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe, yeah. Delta told me to wait here, so I came first.
What about the last chocolate?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It's all thanks to your superb performance, Commander.
Delta points toward the desk.
All the chocolates we'd stolen are lined up neatly,
with the golden bunny chocolate placed at the very end.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Mission accomplished.
Wow, and in such a short time too... very impressive.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: It's all thanks to you throwing yourself at them to draw their attention.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Great work, everyone!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I really don't think I was of any help...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: H-honestly, it might've been better if the two of you had gone alone...

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That's not true at all.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: We were only able to push through because all of us were together.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I've learned that this is the true strength of the Thieves of Justice.
Precisely.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: S–so that's how it is!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: The Thieves of Justice are really amazing!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe, it was an honor teaming up as the Thieves of Chocolate with such wonderful people!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Once again, thank you so much for your help.
Crust bows her head toward Delta and me.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Thanks to you, no one got sick, and we can all enjoy Valentine's Day.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Honestly... if I'd eaten all of those chocolates, I'd have suffered a fate worse than an upset stomach.
Thanks for the help. Both of you.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: I should be the grateful one, I'm glad I got to be part of the Thieves of Chocolate with such exemplary people.
Well then, since everything's wrapped up so nicely, let's disband for...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Oh, wait!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: What should we do with all these chocolates we stole?
Good question...
I look at the beautifully-shaped chocolates piled on the desk.
So much care was put into them,
but I can neither eat them or throw them away.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Yeah.
There's nothing else we can do. I'll find a safe place to stash them.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I think it'd be best if you kept them, Mr. Gourmand.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: After all, they were all made for you, right?

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Correct. All of them expressed the intention to gift these to you, Commander.
Right. I guess they were all meant for me...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: D-does that mean...
If I was going to end up receiving them anyway...
We didn't have to steal any of this at all...?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: ... I suppose?

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: He...hehehe...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehehe! S-still, everything turned out fine in the end!
I-I guess you're right, and that's what matters.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Correct! Justice has been upheld, and that's all that matters!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Oh, that reminds me! There's something I want to give you both.
Crust holds out two beautifully wrapped boxes.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe. I prepared these while you were retrieving the last chocolate.
Thanks, Crust.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: They're nothing compared to what Crust made, but I picked these up along the way.
Delta hands some chocolates to Crust and me.
Thanks, Delta.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Wow! Thanks so much, Delta!
Sorry, I wasn't able to prepare anything...

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: It's okay. Today is Valentine's Day, after all.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: That's right. Today is a day when you're allowed to receive gifts only.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: Hehe. Well, the gifts are delivered and the job is done!

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: I'll be heading out now.

lines.speaker: crust
lines.text: See you two next time!
Crust heads outside.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Then I shall also take my leave. Until we meet again.

lines.speaker: delta_n
lines.text: Nin-nin!
Delta vanishes up into the ceiling.
Finally... freedom.
Maybe it's because I spent all day crouched and crawling through vents,
but my whole body aches.
Ugh... I need to lie down.
*Thud*
Lying on the bed, I stare at the chocolates piled high on the desk.
Never mind, I should put those away before they melt.
*Step, step, step, step*
I hear someone's footsteps.
*Thud, thud, thud, thud, thud*
No, it sounds like more than one person.
... This can't be good.
I jump up and rush toward the desk...
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Stop right there, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I knew it, the Great Red Bullet Mark III is here after all.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You dirty chocolate thief!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ha! Everything really is here.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Unbelievable... So the Commander really was the thief.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You even managed to steal chocolates from this many people?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Very impressive, Commander.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: The Great Red Bullet Mark III was here all along!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Honestly, pulling off stealing all those chocolates is incredible, Master!
How did you even get in here?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The chocolates we made had my special sauce on them. I can track them by scent.
You can track them down that way?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't think that kind of cheap disguise would fool us, Junior Blockhead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Do you have any idea how hard I worked to make sure this stuff wasn't lethal when ingested?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I get wanting to receive chocolate, but to steal it before it's even finished?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I was going to bring it to you once it was done...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Stealing it without saying anything is so cruel, Commander.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Exactly. That was awful of you, Commander!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Do you have any idea how hard we worked on those?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: You just left the chocolate and disappeared without a word!

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: And that "compensation chocolate" of yours was the same for everyone.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: There was no thought behind it at all.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: You jerk...!

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I actually believed you'd come to see us, Sweetie!

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: How could you lie so casually to our faces?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: That was wrong of you, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: If you'd just asked for chocolate when you came looking, we would've given it to you.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: You didn't have to throw a smoke bomb to deceive us!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: R-right. You could've just said you wanted chocolate...

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Wh-why did you trick us?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Lying is really bad, Commander!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: No matter how much you wanted chocolate, how could you trick that many people like that...?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: That's truly mean of you.
It's not that I wanted chocolate...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Uh... am I the only one who can't understand what's going on right now?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So... the thief earlier was you, Cadet? You were the one who threw that shuriken and made off with the chocolates?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How is that even possible? Aren't you human?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Listen, Mister. I know you wanted chocolate really badly.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: And I honestly don't mind that you stole the chocolate I made.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: But you left the exact same apology chocolate for everyone?

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Not to mention how you threw it at our heads. I have to give you props, it was a pretty creative way to give a gift.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: No matter how fond I am of you, {AccountData.NickName}-kun,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: and even if I overlook how chummy you are with the girls at this Outpost,

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: I never imagined you'd be so bold

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: as to practically announce it to the entire base.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Besides, isn't this chocolate made by Crust?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Aha! ♡ That look on your face says it all.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Giving a chocolate made by one girl as a gift to another girl.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: That's very naughty of you, Honey.
I swear, there's a perfectly good explanation for all of this!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'm sure there is. There always is one.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If you'd explained everything to us beforehand, we wouldn't have been any problems.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But you chose not to be open with us.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: And now, the price you have to pay is to eat the chocolates we made for you.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You'll eat them, won't you?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Yeah, you've gotta eat them!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Eat up, Junior Blockhead.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You're gonna eat them all, right, Commander?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: I have full faith that you'll give them a taste.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Consider this your karma, Newbie.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: I'm looking forward to your chocolate eating show, Sweetie.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'm sure you'll enjoy them, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Y-yeah, you'll take a bite, right, Pit Boss?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Enjoy your chocolates, Commander. I'll have digestive medicine ready to go.

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Eat up and enjoy, Mister.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Enjoy, {AccountData.NickName}-kun.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If you're gonna go all in, might as well enjoy it, Cadet!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Come on, Sweetie, take a bite! ♡
... Okay.
That day... I end up eating every last piece chocolate, and my stomach pays a terrible price for it.
For a long while afterward, I can't so much as look at chocolate.
I swear that I'll never again do something as stupid as stealing someone else's chocolate.
CHOCOLATE PLEASE: END
